title: Eeligator
hook: Player-safe note: A blackwater predator with an alligator's jaws, an eel's coiling body, green-blue eyes, and whiskered fins that read the river before prey knows it has been noticed.

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: Long sinuous reptile-fish body, dark wet scales, eel-like whiskers, glowing green-blue eyes, long toothy snout, and reeds bending around its coil.
